purpose: Run the fixed full-chain test after making the Planner phase/root and evidence-authority contracts explicit; evaluate the unchanged three-order Selector vote without StateTune.

global_attempt_cap.counting_rule: Each launched full-chain runner invocation counts, including the invalid v1 run; readiness-only failures before a case starts do not count.

hidden_acceptance.use: post-execution strict acceptance only; unavailable during generation

fixed_runtime.selector_vote_rule: majority; a three-way tie uses median canonical rank, then median standardized logit, then canonical class order
fixed_runtime.abstain_policy: ABSTAIN raw logit is recorded but ineligible on an executable frontier

fixed_metrics.success_threshold: at least one valid run passes strict acceptance
required_diagnostics: Planner patch validity and exact phase sequence
per-order Selector label, input digest, token position, and raw logits
action count and Executor request count
fixed_metrics.reference_similarity_role: diagnostic only; never overrides strict acceptance

stopping_rule: Stop after the first strict pass or after the two remaining invocations. If neither passes, choose the best valid run by audited completed steps, then action count, then fewer protocol rejections. Do not change prompts, weights, thresholds, menu orders, or StateTune data between these runs.

generation.command_template: /home/chase/.local/bin/uv run rwkv-lh-e2e --output <run_directory> --supervisor openai --supervisor-strategy goal_stages --suite agentladderv1 --case AGENT-LADDER-L1-FIX01 --max-transitions 240 --tool-disclosure-mode progressive --concurrency 1 --independent-selector --stateful-goal
generation.run_directory_policy: new immutable directories; never overwrite a prior run
